article.headline: Mercyhurst secures 91-83 win over LIU
article.description: — Qadir Martin had 25 points in Mercyhurst's 91-83 victory against LIU on Saturday.

categories.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Mercyhurst Lakers

event.description: Long Island University Sharks @ Mercyhurst Lakers

keywords: Long Island University Sharks @ Mercyhurst Lakers
article.story: ERIE, Pa. -- — Qadir Martin had 25 points in Mercyhurst's 91-83 victory against LIU on Saturday. Martin also contributed nine rebounds for the Lakers (14-15, 9-7 Northeast Conference). Jake Lemelman scored 20 points while going 6 of 14 from the floor, including 3 of 6 from 3-point range, and 5 of 6 from the line. Bernie Blunt had 18 points and shot 5 of 15 from the floor and 7 of 9 from the free-throw line. Jamal Fuller finished with 26 points and two blocks for the Sharks (19-10, 13-3). LIU also got 18 points from Greg Gordon. Malachi Davis had 15 points and four assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
